def placements_union(G,color):
    R,C=len(G),len(G[0]); pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(G) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}; h=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; w=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    union=set(); origins=[]
    for a in range(R-h+1):
      for b in range(C-w+1):
        if all(G[a+dr][b+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
          origins.append((a,b)); union.update((a+dr,b+dc) for dr,dc in shape)
    return shape,origins,union
